AbpApiDefinition.name: AbpApiDefinition
AbpApiDefinition.description: ABP · API Definition: exposes /api/abp/api-definition with the HTTP API contract model for generate-proxy / dynamic clients (not OpenAPI).

AbpApplicationConfiguration.name: AbpApplicationConfiguration
AbpApplicationConfiguration.description: ABP · Application Configuration: exposes /api/abp/application-configuration with runtime Config State (user, permissions, settings, features, tenant, clock).

AbpApplicationLocalization.name: AbpApplicationLocalization
AbpApplicationLocalization.description: ABP · Application Localization: returns localization resources by cultureName for SPA i18n; can complement application-configuration.

AbpTenant.name: AbpTenant
AbpTenant.description: ABP · Tenant resolve: resolve tenant by name or id for login / gateway (__tenant).

Account.name: Account
Account.description: Account: self-registration and password reset. See Login for session; Profile for my-profile.

Login.name: Login
Login.description: Account · Login session: cookie login/logout/check-password. Prefer /connect/token for Bearer SPA.

Profile.name: Profile
Profile.description: Account · Profile: current user profile and change-password.

DynamicClaims.name: DynamicClaims
DynamicClaims.description: Account · Dynamic Claims: refresh dynamic claims after role/permission changes.

Features.name: Features
Features.description: FeatureManagement: get/update/clear feature values by provider (tenant/edition).

Permissions.name: Permissions
Permissions.description: PermissionManagement: grant permissions by role/user provider and resource-level APIs.

EmailSettings.name: EmailSettings
EmailSettings.description: SettingManagement · Email: SMTP settings and send-test-email.

TimeZoneSettings.name: TimeZoneSettings
TimeZoneSettings.description: SettingManagement · Timezone: get/update app timezone and list options.

Role.name: Role
Role.description: Identity · Roles: CRUD and list roles for administration.

User.name: User
User.description: Identity · Users: user CRUD, lookup by name/email, assign roles.

UserLookup.name: UserLookup
UserLookup.description: Identity · User lookup: lightweight search/count for pickers (not full user admin).

Tenant.name: Tenant
Tenant.description: TenantManagement: host-side tenant CRUD and default connection string.

GET /api/abp/api-definition.description:
**Module:** AbpApiDefinition (Swagger Tag: `AbpApiDefinition`)

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/abp/api-definition`

**Purpose**

Get API definition model.

**Parameters**

- `includeTypes` (bool，默认 false)：为 true 时填充 `types` (DTO/枚举属性与校验元数据)。
- `includeDescriptions` (bool，默认 false)：为 true 时尽量带上 XML 注释中的 Summary/Description。

**Semantics**

Returns the corresponding DTO or empty body per ABP conventions. See response schema and examples.

**When to use**

Use when you need: Get API definition model. Prefer this documented endpoint over ad-hoc HTTP calls.

**Parameters**

Returns the corresponding DTO or empty body per ABP conventions. See response schema and examples.

**When to use**

Use when you need: Get application runtime configuration. Prefer this documented endpoint over ad-hoc HTTP calls.

GET /api/abp/application-localization.description:
**Module:** AbpApplicationLocalization (Swagger Tag: `AbpApplicationLocalization`)

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/abp/application-localization`

**Purpose**

Get localization texts by culture.

**Parameters**

- `cultureName` (string，**required**)：文化代码，如 `en`、`zh-Hans`。不传返回 400。
- `onlyDynamics` (bool，默认 false)：true 时只返回动态本地化 (库内覆盖)；静态 JSON 不返回。Blazor/MVC 已内嵌静态资源时可设 true。

**Semantics**

Returns the corresponding DTO or empty body per ABP conventions. See response schema and examples.

**When to use**

Use when you need: Get localization texts by culture. Prefer this documented endpoint over ad-hoc HTTP calls.
